HYPOTHESIS (answer to the question):
The two least-used documentation formats for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are **BDD scenarios (Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios)** and the **ML Canvas (Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas)**. Among the 194 respondents who answered the Q10 documentation block (82 '-77'/missing rows excluded), BDD scenarios were indicated by 2.062% (4/194; 95% bootstrap CI [0.515, 4.124]) and the ML Canvas by 7.732% (15/194; 95% bootstrap CI [4.124, 11.856]) — the two lowest shares among the 10 concrete formats (all others: 14.948%–34.021%). The ranking is unchanged under sensitivity denominators (n=276: 1.449% / 5.435%; n=188: 2.128% / 7.979%). CIs come from a respondent-level non-parametric bootstrap (10,000 resamples with replacement, seed 42, percentile method). Caveats: the 'Others' catch-all is exactly tied with the ML Canvas (15/194 = 7.732%) but is excluded from the ranking; 'Not_Documented' is not a format and is excluded; our estimates differ from the question's stated 10.13% [9.926, 10.333] and 4.366% [4.231, 4.501], which likely come from a different data vintage or statistic, though the identified pair matches that ordering.

RESULTS TABLE (n=194; count, %, 95% CI):
1. BDD_Scenarios 4 — 2.062% [0.515, 4.124] ← least used
2. MLCanvas 15 — 7.732% [4.124, 11.856] ← second least used
3. Others 15 — 7.732% [4.124, 11.856] (tie; excluded from ranking)
4. Vision_Document 29 — 14.948% [10.309, 20.103]
5. Goal_Models 29 — 14.948% [10.309, 20.103]
6. Not_Documented 30 — 15.464% [10.825, 20.619] (not a format)
7. Data_Models 34 — 17.526% [12.371, 23.196]
8. Use_Case_Models 38 — 19.588% [14.433, 25.258]
9. Prototypes 42 — 21.649% [15.979, 27.320]
10. Requirements_Lists 51 — 26.289% [20.103, 32.474]
11. User_Stories 63 — 32.474% [25.773, 39.175]
12. Notebooks 66 — 34.021% [27.320, 40.722]

Artifacts: analysis_q10_bootstrap.py (executed script) and q10_bootstrap_results.csv (full table).

payload.hypothesis: The two least-used documentation formats for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are BDD (behavior-driven development) scenarios and the ML Canvas. Among the 194 respondents who answered the Q10 documentation block (82 '-77'/missing rows excluded), BDD scenarios were indicated by only 2.062% of respondents (4/194; 95% bootstrap CI [0.515, 4.124]) and the ML Canvas by 7.732% (15/194; 95% bootstrap CI [4.124, 11.856]), the two lowest usage shares among the 10 documented formats (all others ranged 14.948% to 34.021%). Estimates are robust to the denominator: with all 276 respondents (missing counted as not used) the figures are 1.449% and 5.435%, and with the 188 completed respondents 2.128% and 7.979%, leaving the ranking unchanged. CIs were obtained by non-parametric respondent-level bootstrap (10,000 resamples with replacement, seed 42, percentile method). Two caveats: the 'Others' free-text category is exactly tied with the ML Canvas (15/194 = 7.732%) but was excluded from the ranking as a catch-all, and 'Not_Documented' (30/194) was excluded as it is not a documentation format; also, our point estimates and CI widths differ from the question's stated figures (10.13% [9.926, 10.333] and 4.366% [4.231, 4.501]), which appear to come from a different data vintage or statistic, but the identified least-used pair (BDD scenarios, ML Canvas) is consistent with that ordering.
payload.workflow: 1) Loaded data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv (276 respondents x 202 columns). 2) Verified the 12 Q10_ML_Documentation_* columns are binary indicators ('quoted' = format used, 'not quoted' = not used) plus a '-77' break sentinel; the 82 '-77' rows (all Status='Suspended (22)') were excluded as missing, leaving n=194. 3) Computed per-format usage percentages as 100 x count('quoted')/194, with sensitivity on n=276 and n=188. 4) Ran a non-parametric respondent-level bootstrap (10,000 resamples with replacement, fixed seed 42), recomputing each format's percentage per resample and taking the 2.5th/97.5th percentiles as 95% CIs. 5) Ranked the 10 concrete documentation formats (excluding 'Not_Documented' and the 'Others' catch-all) and identified the two least used: BDD_Scenarios (2.062%) and MLCanvas (7.732%, tied with Others at 7.732%). 6) Compared results to the question's stated values and documented the discrepancy.
